propositions: _mkdir_lock_is_stale has uncovered branches for non-int PID, missing colon separator, and owner-file read errors (OSError).
_mkdir_lock_is_stale must return False (never reclaim) when the ownership stamp is malformed or unreadable.

A table-driven test must cover empty owner file, missing colon, empty host, empty PID, non-numeric PID, negative PID, zero PID, extra delimiters, foreign host, directory in place of owner file, and partial mid-write stamps.
Placing a directory at the owner-file path causes IsADirectoryError (OSError) that _mkdir_lock_is_stale must handle conservatively by returning False.
